mapper.update: UPDATE sms_so_sales_customer cust SET cust.sale_user_id = NULL WHERE cust.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT t.customer_id FROM ( SELECT proj.customer_id FROM sms_so_sales_project proj LEFT JOIN ( SELECT project_id, MAX(visit_date) AS max_visit_date FROM sms_so_sales_visit WHERE active = 'Y' GROUP BY project_id ) visitMax ON proj.id = visitMax.project_id WHERE proj.active = 'Y' GROUP BY proj.customer_id HAVING MAX(IFNULL(visitMax.max_visit_date,'1970-01-01')) < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ) t ) AND cust.active = 'Y' AND cust.sale_user_id IS NOT NULL;
